basedOn: Standard physiology: peripheral glucose appearance shaped by gastric emptying, fiber and matrix; insulin-driven clearance back toward baseline. Teaching shape, not a personal reading.
sources: NIDDK - Your Digestive System & How It Works: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/digestive-system-how-it-works
Hall & Hall, Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. - Unit XII, Gastrointestinal Physiology
Boron & Boulpaep, Medical Physiology, 3rd ed. - The Gastrointestinal System

inputs.description: Teaching proxy only - not a personal reading

appearance.label: Peripheral glucose appearance
appearance.detail: Glucose that cleared the liver appears in peripheral blood - the CGM-like shape, driven by everything upstream (emptying rate, fiber, matrix). Teaching shape, not your meter.

shapeChoice.label: Curve shape
shapeChoice.detail: Fast-emptying, low-fiber, refined loads produce a sharp rise; buffered whole-food meals produce a gentle one.

sharpRise.label: Sharp rise
sharpRise.detail: Steep glucose appearance and a larger insulin response; a bigger post-peak dip is the teaching cost.

edgeCases.effect: Higher, more prolonged elevation for the same load - the appearance clears more slowly.

gentleRise.label: Gentle rise
gentleRise.detail: Blunted appearance, steadier energy, smaller insulin swing - the buffered whole-food shape.

clearance.label: Insulin-driven clearance
clearance.detail: Insulin drives peripheral uptake and the curve returns toward baseline, closing the fed window.
